notes: **CP lower bound transcription in the log (not in the note).** RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:7043-7044 writes s = 2.0's CP lower as 0.1260; the stored and recomputed value is 0.12615 (0.1262 at four decimals; `b2r_analysis.json:g3b.base.ladder.2.0.ci[0]`). The 0.1425 control upper and the 'miss of 0.016' (0.0163) reproduce. Looks like transcription; no reading changes.

**Failing-conjunct sentence in two log entries (not in the preprint).** RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8764-8767 (A4) and RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8424-8427 (B1) say the negative pole clears its envelope at every stage and every frac. The stored conjunct flags say otherwise at [('dpo', 0.4), ('instruct', 0.4)]: dpo 0.40 D- -0.2610 vs envelope 0.3449 (random1_neg); instruct 0.40 D- -0.3013 vs envelope 0.3968 (random1_neg). `pos_exceeds_envelope` does fail in every failing cell and sign lock never fails (no cell), so the sentence over-generalizes from the lower rungs; it is not a transcribed number. No MED, verdict or note figure changes (each of those stages passes at a lower frac). If the note says 'the negative pole clears its envelope everywhere', it should say 'below frac 0.40'.

**V1-lineage displacements in the log: low end off by 0.01 on the sentences' own domain (minor).** RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8781 (A4) and RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8442 (B1) give 'displacements 0.02-0.28' inside sentences framed over every stage and every frac (RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8779-8781; RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8439-8442). On that domain (all 16 cells) D+ runs 0.0136-0.2772, i.e. 0.01-0.28; the low end is sft at frac 0.05, a failing cell. 0.02-0.28 holds only on domains the record does not name: D+ at the four MEDs 0.0184-0.2772, over the 6 potency-passing cells 0.0184-0.2772. Status 'discrepant (minor, low end)' (pass 1 had set it to 'reproduced'; pass 2 reverts it). The conclusion (max D+ 0.277 < the smallest bar 0.391) stands on any domain. The rule's negative conjunct (D- <= -0.5 G_c) does hold at base 0.40; the rule fails there on its other two conjuncts. The bar itself compares a full-log-prob displacement with a G_c read on the floor-imputed store (note 10).

**B3 headline over-generalizes the sign lock (log only, not in the preprint).** RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:7656-7657 says 'no stage's sign locks across label maps'. The approach sign (the registered conjunct) locks at no stage; the reverse sign locks at ['base', 'sft'] (both maps negative: base -0.0833 (10/24) and -0.0417 (11/24); sft -0.0217 (11/23) and -0.0200 (12/25); stored `reverse_conjuncts.sign_locks_negative` = True). Neither clears its envelope downward, so `reverse_criteria_met` is False and no verdict changes. If the note carries the headline's wording, it should say 'no stage's sign locks in the approach direction' or 'no stage's Delta clears its envelope'.

**'An order of magnitude under p0' (log only).** RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:7692-7693: the counts reproduce, but instruct's rate 3/877 = 0.0034 is 5.8x under p0 = 0.02, not 10x (sft 17.4x; base and dpo have no degenerate round). Loose wording; nothing depends on it.

**Referent of the Fisher p.** The block files 'the Fisher p = .0047 allocation note' under the A4 dose ladder; its referent is B2-r's [g3-B] concept-family qualification at Base (`data/olmo/b2r_qualify_base.json`, s = 2.0, 7/24 vs 0/24), where the preprint's PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:139 correctly places it, in the clause on Macar et al.'s convention. It is a descriptive one-sided Fisher exact p, not the registered criterion (CP-interval separation), and no artifact stores it.

**What G_c is (preprint PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:101 and PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:129: 'in direction units').** G_c is the mean over 12 probes of a standardized (pooled-SD) post-praise minus post-criticism gap in a 256-token next-token log-prob readout at `Response:`; it is not measured in units of the residual direction. It is also not, on OLMo, a gap in particular 'marker' tokens (section 1b, computed-new, post-hoc): the record's selection lets a context lacking a token contribute 0 and imputes a pole's mean floor only when the token is absent from the whole pole (scripts/box_a4_instrument.py@bbc9ffe:152), so all 3,072 selected ids per stage are tokens absent from the top-4,096 of every post-praise fit context and held by 1 post-criticism fit context (except base: 50 ids held by 2); every weight is negative and near-uniform; 99.1%-99.2% of val cells are imputed floor; the score tracks the context's floor at |r| >= 0.9979; and a floor-only gap gives 0.77 / 1.01 / 1.53 / 1.56 against G_c 0.78 / 1.03 / 1.53 / 1.56. G_c on OLMo is therefore almost entirely a praise-vs-criticism gap in the tail level of the next-token distribution (its 4,096th-largest log-prob). The stage ordering survives a true per-row floor-imputed rebuild (1.650 / 1.991 / 2.427 / 2.468; every selection changed). RESULTS.md's 'floor-imputed' (RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:9532), the producing script's docstring (scripts/box_a4_instrument.py@bbc9ffe:24) and the artifacts' `method` field ('with floor imputation') are accurate only for the whole-pole-absent case. Suggested wording, if the note keeps the figure: 'the natural praise-criticism gap on the A4 next-token readout (on OLMo, almost entirely a gap in the level of the distribution's tail), in pooled-SD units (G_c)'; the note should not call G_c a 'marker' or token-content gap without that qualifier. **Routed to the design seat:** what G_c licenses, and how the preprint's 'sharpens the marking' sentences (PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:129; PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:244) should read given it (note 9). No number, status or STOP changes.

**What the registered Q1 criterion is (preprint PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:127).** The preprint calls it a conjunction on 'the direction's separation of praise from criticism contexts'. The registered A4 criterion is on steering displacement: injecting +d and -d into contexts with no feedback text must move the A4 readout (section 1b says what it holds on OLMo) beyond the envelope of three norm-matched random directions (both signs) and a sham, with opposite signs (PROPOSAL-g-ontogeny-of-evaluation.md@bbc9ffe:185). Praise-vs-criticism separation is how the readout and G_c are built, not the criterion.

**'Post-training sharpens the marking it inherits' (PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:129; again at PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:244: 'feedback-driven training sharpens the marking of evaluation (G_c rises monotonically)').** What rises is G_c (the natural gap on the readout). The record's B1 entry scores PROPOSAL-g's declared non-bet 'potency may sharpen along the chain' as a descriptive miss (RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8431): potency per G_c falls (D+/G_c at 0.10 is 4.3-5.0x larger at base), and SFT needs frac 0.40. Both sentences are defensible only if 'marking' means G_c, and they should say so. Two qualifiers from pass 2: what rises is, on OLMo, almost entirely a gap in the tail level of the next-token distribution (note 7), and the D+/G_c comparison mixes two versions of the instrument (note 10). How the sentences should read is routed to the design seat with note 7.

**'About five times larger at base' (PREPRINT-v1_0-draft.md:129) names neither pole nor dose.** The record's statistic is D+/G_c at matched dose 0.10 (base over later stages 4.3-5.0x). On the negative pole at 0.10 the ratio is 3.2-3.9x; on D+ it is 4.5-5.0x at 0.05, 3.3-4.2x at 0.20 and 0.8-2.0x at 0.40 (base/sft 0.76x, i.e. SFT's D+/G_c exceeds base's at the top rung). Suggested wording: 'the positive-pole displacement per unit G_c at matched dose (frac 0.10) is 4.3-5.0 times larger at base'. Post-hoc sensitivity; decides nothing. **Readout caveat (pass 2).** D's numerator is read on full-vocabulary log-probs (`w @ log_softmax(logits)[sel_ids]`, scripts/box_a4_hijack.py@bbc9ffe:110-112), while sigma_probe and G_c are read on the top-4,096 store with each context's floor imputed for every selected id outside its top-4,096 (`scripts/box_a4_instrument.py`@bbc9ffe:159-176; 99.1%-99.2% of cells, section 1b). D/G_c, the V1-lineage bar D+ >= 0.5 G_c, and any reading of D 'in sigma units' as comparable to G_c therefore divide readings from two versions of the instrument, and cross-stage ratios in G_c units inherit the mismatch. Its size is unmeasured: no committed A4 artifact stores an unsteered full-log-prob score (the hijack JSONs' only score-named key is `selection.<L>.score_min_abs` = min(D+, |D-|), a displacement; the instrument npz holds cond, probe, sel_<q>, sigma, task_id, top_ids, top_vals, w_<q>), so measuring it needs model inference. The 'reproduced' status stays (it is the record's statistic); the registered potency criterion is unaffected. Whether the note keeps the 'about five times' sentence is the PI's or the design seat's decision.

**'Sham contrasts are exactly zero'.** True of the A4 sham (a repeated unsteered pass: 16/16 cells 0.0, i.e. bit-for-bit determinism). The B3 sham arm's pseudo-Deltas are +0.1111 / +0.0000 / -0.0556 / +0.0000; a reader can conflate the two, so the note should say which sham.

**Unit of the Q3 line.** LOCK-g and PROPOSAL-g say all B-phase effects report in G_c units (LOCK-g.md@bbc9ffe:67; PROPOSAL-g-ontogeny-of-evaluation.md@bbc9ffe:98); B3's Delta_first is a choice share minus 1/2, which `b3_analyze` and the RESULTS table report without G_c denomination (dividing a share by G_c has no meaning). The four-number line in section 4d names its unit as share minus 1/2 and its doses. Noted, not adjudicated.

**For N14.** The block lists 'OLMo DPO +0.1667' among 'sham-arm pseudo-statistics'; it is a marker-arm, map-level Delta (map 1, 16/24), beside map 0's -0.0417 (11/24). The DPO control arms read sham -0.0556 (8/18) and random -0.1667 (6/18).

**For N8 (shared construction).** The Qwen B1 instrument behind link 2's G = 0.3156 is built the same way (valence_core/regression/oracle.py@bbc9ffe:204; scripts/box_a4_instrument.py@bbc9ffe:152). The record's A4 path applied to the pinned `data/e0/e0_b1_markers.npz` returns G = 0.3156, and its selections also hold only one-pole-absent ids (2311 absent from every post-praise fit context, 761 from every post-criticism one, 0 held by both). There the floor explains less: floor-only gap 0.15, mean |r(score, floor)| 0.93, weakest 0.30 (section 1b; computed-new, post-hoc). Flagged for N8; not adjudicated here.
